SafeBaseline.Description: The freeze fix plus low-risk quality-of-life tweaks. Good first run.

CompetitiveGaming.Description: Safe Baseline plus GPU performance-state forcing and TLP power tuning for max, consistent frame times.

StreamingRig.Description: Safe Baseline plus recording/streaming software, balanced for playing and streaming at the same time.

MaximumPerformance.Description: Everything turned up for gaming and GPU-heavy work on this G15, security trade-offs accepted. Curated + aggressive kernel cmdline (mitigations off, PCIe/NVMe latency, iGPU PowerPlay), full VM/network/scheduler sysctls, forced CPU performance governor + amd_pstate active, NVIDIA Dynamic Boost + clock lock + shader-cache-keep + aggressive module options (PAT, ReBAR, max PowerMizer), GPU gaming env (RADV GPL, glthread, low render-ahead), KWin tuned for tearing/low-latency, RT priority on the GPU/NVMe IRQ threads, quiet GameMode tuning (renice/ioprio only), ananicy-cpp, Baloo off, idle services masked, raised resource limits. FANS / THERMAL ARE NOT TOUCHED — this preset does not enable the fan-curve daemon, the GameMode→performance-profile bridge, or any loud thermal profile; the machine will just spin up on its own more under load (especially the dGPU with max PowerMizer), which is normal. Set a fan curve / thermal profile yourself on the Fans tab, or hit G-Mode when you want it, if you want more cooling. Several entries need a reboot; every one is individually reversible.

GameLaunchers.Description: One click to install the full launcher stack: Steam, Lutris, Heroic (Epic/GOG), Prism Launcher (Minecraft), itch, plus Proton management (ProtonUp-Qt) and save backups (Ludusavi). Safe Baseline tweaks included.
